title: Before the interview
summary: The things to have ready the week of the interview.
items: Write the interview GPU's numbers (bandwidth, FP32 and BF16 peak, SM count, registers and shared memory per SM) from memory, and the ridge point.
Write a vector add, a block reduction and a row softmax in CUDA on paper, with bounds checks, in under 15 minutes each.
Write a row softmax in Triton from memory.
Explain coalescing and bank conflicts with an example address pattern for each.
Estimate the memory of a model's training state, its KV cache for a given batch and context, and its batch-1 tokens per second.
Explain flash attention, ring all-reduce and continuous batching in two minutes each, out loud.
Prepare one project of your own to deep-dive: the problem, the numbers before and after, and what you would do next.
Solve one GPU gym kernel on a real GPU and know its benchmark result as a share of the roofline.
